title: Zesty Buttery Venezuelan Chicken Wrap
description: A buttery and snappy Venezuelan dish featuring ginger paste, wrapped in a pandan leaf for a unique and comforting meal, this keto friendly recipe is perfect for a quick dinner
instructions: Submerge the chicken strips in an ice bath for 30 minutes to shock the meat and make it more tender.
Remove the chicken from the ice bath and pat it dry with paper towels to remove excess moisture.
In a large bowl, mix together the ginger paste, melted butter, lime juice, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Add the chicken strips to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the ginger butter mixture.
Wrap each chicken strip in a pandan leaf, making sure to seal the leaf tightly around the chicken.
Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and cook the wrapped chicken for 5-6 minutes on each side, until the chicken is cooked through and the pandan leaf is crispy.
Serve the chicken wraps hot, garnished with additional lime wedges if desired.
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
